newsitem.title: UK: Horse Racing-Jodami may be retired.
newsitem.headline: Horse Racing-Jodami may be retired.

text.p: Brandsby trainer Peter Beaumont on Monday said that Jodami is likely to be retired after rupturing a tendon in his attempt to land Sunday's Hennessy Cognac Gold Cup for the fourth time.

"That will more than likely be it. He was in some pain immediately after the race but settled down later. We'll see what he's like when he gets back and I'll have to speak to Mr Yeadon (Jodami's owner) but time is against him," Beaumont said.
Jodami was due back in North Yorkshire early on Monday afternoon.
Beaumont said Jodami, who landed the race in 1993, 1994 and 1995, may have won but for the injury.
"Taking nothing away from the winner, I felt we might just get there. He ran a great race, it's a great shame," Beaumont said.
Jodami (5-1) finished strongly to come home second,one and a half lengths adrift on Ireland's latest equine star Danoli in Sunday's Hennessy Cognac Gold Cup.
Danoli, a 6-1 chance, had fallen on two of his five previous outings over fences but jumped magnificently on Sunday under jockey Tommy Treacy to land the three-mile (4.8-kms) race.
Imperial Call, winner of the 1996 Cheltenham Gold Cup, finished third, 20 lengths behind Jodami.
